results.title: Rodri wins Ballon d'Or 2024: Man City midfielder pips Vinicius Junior to crown as Barcelona star Aitana Bonmati wins women's award | Football News | Sky Sports
results.content:
Manchester City midfielder Rodri won the men's Ballon d'Or and Barcelona playmaker Aitana Bonmati took the women's award as a "disrespected" Real Madrid boycotted the prestigious ceremony in Paris despite being named men's club of the year.

Rodri beat the Real Madrid trio of Vinicius Junior, Dani Carvajal and Jude Bellingham to the top honour, and that verdict from the 100-strong panel of voters led the delegation from the Spanish giants to stay at home. [...] Meanwhile, Real Madrid boss Carlo Ancelotti won the Johan Cruyff Trophy as men's coach of the year while former Chelsea coach Emma Hayes collected the women's version having led the USA to Olympic gold in the summer.

Real were named the men's club of the year while Kylian Mbappe also missed the chance to pick up the Gerd Muller trophy he won jointly with Harry Kane as the Real Madrid delegation stayed at home. [...] In a statement reported by Spanish newspaper AS, the club said: "If the award criteria doesn't give it to Vinicius as the winner, then those same criteria should point to (Dani) Carvajal as the winner.

"As this was not the case, it is clear that Ballon d'Or does not respect Real Madrid. Real Madrid does not go where it is not respected."

Mbappe and Kane shared the Gerd Muller trophy after both players finished last season with 52 goals, but only Kane was on hand to collected the award.
